description: ACP is the cross-agent yardstick: mapped means the casm protocol has an equivalent concept, whether or not every provider fills it.

agent:authenticate.reason: Agent login and credentials are set up on the host by the user; casm doesn't manage agent auth.

agent:document/didChange.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:document/didClose.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:document/didFocus.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:document/didOpen.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:document/didSave.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:initialize.note: Protocol version and capabilities; casm has no per-session capability negotiation.

agent:logout.reason: Agent login and credentials are set up on the host by the user; casm doesn't manage agent auth.

agent:mcp/message.reason: MCP tunnelled over the client connection; casm instead configures MCP servers per agent (AgentConfig.mcpServers) and the agent connects to them itself.

agent:nes/accept.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:nes/close.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:nes/reject.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:nes/start.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:nes/suggest.reason: Editor integration (open-buffer sync, next-edit suggestions); casm clients are chat clients and agents read files from the host.

agent:providers/disable.reason: Unstable LLM-provider configuration (keys, endpoints); agent administration is done on the host.

agent:providers/list.reason: Unstable LLM-provider configuration (keys, endpoints); agent administration is done on the host.

agent:providers/set.reason: Unstable LLM-provider configuration (keys, endpoints); agent administration is done on the host.

agent:session/close.note: Drops the live process; the next send reopens the session.

agent:session/set_config_option.note: Fixed fields instead of generic options; applied on reload.

client:elicitation/complete.note: URL-mode elicitation completion can't resolve a pending question.

client:fs/read_text_file.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem.

client:fs/write_text_file.reason: Agents run on the host, so casm doesn't proxy the filesystem.

client:mcp/message.reason: MCP tunnelled over the client connection; casm configures MCP servers per agent instead.

client:session/request_permission.note: Options are fixed to allow / allowAlways / deny.

client:terminal/create.reason: Agents run commands on the host themselves; casm doesn't provide client-side terminals.

client:terminal/kill.reason: Agents run commands on the host themselves; casm doesn't provide client-side terminals.

client:terminal/output.reason: Agents run commands on the host themselves; casm doesn't provide client-side terminals.

client:terminal/release.reason: Agents run commands on the host themselves; casm doesn't provide client-side terminals.

client:terminal/wait_for_exit.reason: Agents run commands on the host themselves; casm doesn't provide client-side terminals.

content:audio.note: Item and agent.send are text only.

content:image.note: Item and agent.send are text only.

content:resource.note: No embedded resources (file contents attached to a prompt).

content:resource_link.note: No resource links (file references attached to a prompt).

protocol:$/cancel_request.note: casm's JSON-RPC has no request cancellation (e.g. for a long agent.wait).

toolContent:diff.note: No structured diff; Codex puts diffs into the output text.

update:compaction_update.note: Compaction is a notice (Codex, pi history); no structured compaction.

update:config_option_update.note: AgentConfig is carried by agent.changed, but no provider reports agent-initiated changes.

update:current_mode_update.note: AgentConfig.mode is carried by agent.changed, but no provider reports agent-initiated mode changes.

update:session_info_update.note: Agent.name is user-set; agent-generated titles aren't carried.

update:subagent_update.note: Subagents aren't modelled (casm has parent links only for casm-created agents).

update:tool_call_update.note: Upsert by id; status running/done/error. No tool kind, locations or structured content.
